dataset.target: Leading space, one demonstrated continuation sentence, EOS2; prompt/BOS/padding ignored
dataset.packing: One independent example per right-padded row; continuous positions; no cross-example attention
dataset.provenance: TinyStories sentences from existing frozen document splits plus locally authored deterministic templates. Natural training prose was seen during checkpoint pretraining. Synthetic evaluation names are disjoint, templates shared.
dataset.limitations: Template transfer and short TinyStories continuation do not establish broad co-writing quality. Test is reserved until final evaluation.

choices: Authored fact-sensitive templates plus natural TinyStories continuations, Scene/User/Reply labels, lr1e-4 to1e-5, warmup100, reply48, fresh optimizer, best-validation deployment. Timing starts at first training step and includes periodic validation/saves.
